# Which screens to photograph, and in which appearance.
#
# Edit this file and commit — the Preview screens workflow runs on the change and
# posts the shots into its job log (and as artifacts). GitHub's web editor works
# fine from a phone.
#
# screens:    studio, home, archive, course, summit, yearbook, prints, wall-art,
#             map-studio, gallery-studio, detail, components
#             wall-art accepts a style: wall-art:grid, wall-art:ridgeline, wall-art:rings,
#             wall-art:thread, wall-art:strata
#             timeline accepts a scope: timeline:years, timeline:months, timeline:all,
#             timeline:gallery
#             print-engine runs the print writer's self-check and reports pass/fail
# appearance: light, dark, or both
#
# Requested for b539: the Design tab's new three-axis IA.
#
#   map-studio — the Design tab now asks three orthogonal questions in order: Layout
#   (Nameplate/Statement/Minimal/Photo/Full Bleed), Style (Streets/Terrain/Contour/
#   Satellite/No Map), and Color (Etch/Bright/Dark/Noir/Harbor/Mono chips). The old
#   "Start here" preset row is gone. What to check: the three row labels, the Layout
#   thumbnails rendering as five arrangements of this piece, and the six Color chips.
#
# screens: a product tile can be named directly, e.g. studio@lithograph

screens=collections
appearance=light

# b563 — the Collections crash hardening. The seeded repro did NOT crash (46-page Races
# collection rendered clean), pointing at device-only conditions: preview rendering
# loaded every photograph at its 1500px PRINT size, and a big collection previews up to
# a hundred pages of that back to back — a memory spike an empty simulator library never
# feels. Previews now load photos at preview size (print export still asks full size),
# each page render sits in an autorelease pool, and the photo sheet de-duplicates a
# library asset attached to two activities. This shot re-verifies collections stays green.

# b562 — trim safety and hidden pages. The device shot of the Grid cover showed the type
# pressed against the edges: the LazyVGrid demanded more height than the page has, the
# cover overflowed, and the safety paddings + accent rule + ETCH foot were what got
# clipped. The band is flexible rows now. @cover-grid must show: the accent rule ABOVE
# "A YEAR IN MOTION" with clear air over it, and "ETCH" at the foot below the totals —
# both were missing in the overflowing version. @years/@resume re-verify the tightened
# ledgers (9 and 12 rows inside the margins). Hide-a-page (touch and hold a page →
# Hide, Restore in the footer) is verified by build here, by hand on device.

# b561 — Year Book Phase 4: the portfolio closes the book, and the cover learns choices.
#   @years      — "THE RECORD SO FAR / THE YEARS": a ledger row per year of the whole
#                 history (activities · miles · races · states), the book's own year in
#                 accent with a THIS BOOK tag, lifetime line at the foot.
#   @resume     — "EVERY START LINE / RACE HISTORY": the lifetime race résumé, newest
#                 first — date, name, № finish in accent when known, distance, time.
#   @atlas      — "EVERYWHERE, EVER / THE ATLAS": country outlines framed to the visited
#                 world, an accent pin for every city ever, lifetime totals beneath.
#   @cover-grid — the anthology cover: every route of the span as a wall of small bone
#                 lines on ink, same eyebrow/title/ETCH stations as the statement cover.
# The photo-curation sheet (toolbar photo button → include/exclude, add from library,
# Use on the cover, Republish) is verified by build here and by hand on device.

# b559 — Year Book Phase 2 begins: THE MAP. A new spread after the marks — the year's
# geography, all self-rendered vectors. What to check: the visited states filled in the
# blue tercile ramp with unvisited neighbours as hairlines, ink city dots sized by
# activity count, accent stars on race days, the legend line under the figure, and the
# callout column on the right (THE GROUND / MOST MILES / MOST-RUN CITY / RACE DAYS /
# THE SPAN) set in the marks page's card language.

# b555 — the Anthology nameplate. Both shots seed the plate at the bottom: the rings /
# ridgeline art redrawn INSIDE the upper field (never overlapping), and beneath it the
# block — "JORDAN AVERY" eyebrow tracked small, "A YEAR IN MOTION" in the serif, a short
# hairline rule, then "2019 – 2026 · N ACTIVITIES · X MI" in small caps, all in the
# palette's own ink, centred in the band.

# b554 — the statement cover. The first shot lands on the cover: deep ink ground, blue
# accent rule + eyebrow, the hero route drawn in bone with the new endpoint marks, the
# year enormous in bone serif, a hairline, the year's line of numbers, and a small ETCH
# mark — a coffee-table object, not an interior page promoted to the front. @closing
# verifies the interior still sits on bone (the ink is the covers' alone). The lens
# picker (All Activity / Runs / Rides / Hikes) only appears for multi-sport histories,
# which the seeded data isn't — verified by build here, by hand on device.

# b553 — the Photo template grows up. :photo should show THREE frames under the map (the
# seeded subject has no photos, so all three are the new placeholder tiles: hairline
# border, glyph, "ADD A PHOTO"), and the route's new endpoint marks — open ring start,
# solid point finish, fine accent halo when it's a race; the chequer is gone. :bordered
# is the same sheet with the map framed inside the 70pt margin, aligned with the photo
# strip, bone border wrapping the whole print.

# b552 — Year Book Phase 1 (story foundation; docs/yearbook-strategy.md is the brief of
# record). Five pages to judge:
#   @marks  — "THE MARKS": 3×2 achievement cards (values big, labels in accent, detail under)
#   @review — "YOUR YEAR, ETCHED.": serif hero mileage, highlights ledger, places line
#   @index  — "The Record": three columns of compact date·name·distance entries
#   @quiet  — a sparse month: one large accent route left, ledger of activities right
#   @month  — a standard month: marquee cell (accent, bigger, own stats) + 3-col grid +
#             "+N more — in the record" honesty line when the month overflows
